nongui.description: Whether to run JMeter in non-GUI (CLI) mode.

server.description: Whether to run JMeter in server mode. If true, nongui should typically be false or irrelevant.

testfile.description: Path to the JMeter test plan file (.jmx).

property_file.description: Path to the primary JMeter property file to use.

additional_prop_files.description: List of additional JMeter property file paths to add (-q). Items are strings.

logfile.description: Path to the file to log samples to (-l).

jmeter_logfile.description: Path to the JMeter run log file (-j).

homedir.description: The JMeter home directory to use (-d).

remote_exit.description: Exit remote servers at end of test in non-GUI mode (-X).

loglevels.description: List of log level settings in 'category=level' format (-L). Items are strings.

jmeter_properties.description: List of additional JMeter properties in 'key=value' format (-J). Items are strings.

global_properties.description: List of global properties to send to servers in 'key=value' format (-G). Items are strings.

system_properties.description: List of additional Java system properties in 'key=value' format (-D). Items are strings.

system_property_files.description: List of system property file paths (-S). Items are strings.

run_remote.description: Start remote servers as defined in remote_hosts (-r).

remote_servers.description: List of remote servers to start, overriding remote_hosts (-R).
